reason: README shows a Chronos-2 predict_df forecasting example; the 120M model runs fine on CPU and is ungated on Hugging Face.
goal: Install the chronos-forecasting package from the repo clone (plus pandas with pyarrow) so that `from chronos import Chronos2Pipeline` works. Then load amazon/chronos-2 with device_map='cpu' and run pipeline.predict_df on a long-format DataFrame (columns id, timestamp, target) with prediction_length=24 and quantile_levels=[0.1,0.5,0.9]. The README's electricity_price parquet example is the reference; it must produce a forecast DataFrame with predictions and quantile columns. Provide /work/env.sh that activates the environment so `python` can import chronos.
check: The hidden test runs a CPU forecast on a synthetic multi-series dataset and verifies the output has the right shape, the quantile columns, finite values and ordered quantiles.
